name: Import Form Diagram (COMPAS CEM)
description: Create a COMPAS CEM form diagram from JSON file.

inputParameters.name: read
inputParameters.description: Reads the form diagram from the JSON file when True. The component outputs nothing while it is False.

inputParameters.name: filepath
inputParameters.description: The full filepath to the JSON file that stores the diagram. Do not forget to add the extension .json to the filename.
